newsitem.title: LATVIA: AGENCY OKAYS VENTSPILS, LATVENERGO SALE RULES.
newsitem.headline: AGENCY OKAYS VENTSPILS, LATVENERGO SALE RULES.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency on Wednesday said it approved the rules for the sale of major oil terminal Ventspils Nafta and pipeline operator Lasam and the guidelines for the selloff of Latvenergo.
The agency said in a statement that the board approved the rules at a meeting on April 29. It provided no further details.
The preliminary rules drawn up by the agency included a four-stage process that would see the merger of Ventspils with Lasam and a privatisation to leave the state with 26 percent.
The capital of the company was planned to rise to 200 million lats from 30 million lats with the first public offers taking place in July.
The agency also said that the board approved the guidelines for the sale of state electricity company Latvenergo, in which German and other Western companies have expressed an interest.
The agency earlier invited bids for around 25 percent to 35 percent of Latvenergo. It may be made into a a holding with its energy activities split into daugher companies.
